candidate_profile.title: Senior Full-Stack .NET & Vue.js Engineer
candidate_profile.primary_domain: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Migration, Production Support & Modernization
candidate_profile.primary_stack: .NET Core / C# & Modern Vue.js (Vue 3 / Composition API)
candidate_profile.legacy_maintenance_stack: ASP.NET MVC, JavaScript, jQuery, MS SQL Server
candidate_profile.core_philosophy: Building scalable, high-throughput modern ERP architectures while maintaining high uptime and stability for legacy enterprise systems.

legacy_system_focus10.stack: ASP.NET MVC, JavaScript, jQuery, Razor Views, MS SQL Server
legacy_system_focus10.responsibilities_and_support: Active production support, resolving client tickets / ETs (Error Tracking issues), fixing legacy bugs, optimizing slow stored procedures, and ensuring business continuity.

modern_system_focusXI.stack: ASP.NET Web API (.NET Core), C#, Modern Vue.js (Vue 3 / `<script setup>`), Pinia, Tailwind CSS
modern_system_focusXI.design_workflow: Directly translating Figma design tokens, interactive prototypes, and component design systems into pixel-perfect, responsive Vue 3 components.
modern_system_focusXI.migration_highlights: Decoupling legacy monolithic MVC views into clean RESTful APIs and lightweight single-page applications (SPA), modernizing state management with Pinia, and improving initial page load and rendering performance.

budgets_and_financials.core_functionality: Fiscal year budgeting, variance analysis (budgeted vs. actuals), cost center allocations, ledger postings, and audit trails.
budgets_and_financials.technical_implementation: Handled precision calculations with `decimal` in C# to avoid floating-point drift, implemented atomic multi-table ledger transactions via SQL transactions and Unit of Work, and applied strict concurrency tokens to prevent double-spending.

dashboards_and_data_visualization.core_functionality: Real-time KPI metrics, revenue/expense trends, inventory turnover rates, and operational health summaries.
dashboards_and_data_visualization.technical_implementation: Integrated charting libraries (Chart.js / ECharts / ApexCharts) into Vue 3 `<script setup>`, optimized reactivity using `markRaw` / `shallowRef` to prevent reactivity overhead on huge datasets, handled dynamic canvas resizing on window changes, and implemented backend aggregation endpoints with Redis caching.

enterprise_reporting_engine.core_functionality: High-volume transactional reports, fiscal summaries, dynamic column filters, grouping, sorting, and export pipelines (Excel / CSV / PDF).
enterprise_reporting_engine.technical_implementation: Optimized heavy aggregate queries using indexed views, CTEs, and execution plan tuning in SQL Server; used `IQueryable` streaming with `.AsNoTracking()` in EF Core / Dapper to avoid memory bloat; rendered tabular data with virtual scrolling on the frontend and offloaded large exports to background jobs.

other_core_modules: WMS (Warehouse Management System) - Multi-bin tracking, FIFO/LIFO valuation, and stock audits.
Fixed Assets - Depreciation scheduling (Straight Line / WDV) and asset transfers.
POS & MRP - High-speed checkout, real-time stock deduction, and production demand planning.
Masters & Dynamic Forms - Metadata-driven enterprise forms, dynamic field rendering, and validation pipelines.

frontend_expertise.framework_and_paradigm: Vue 3 with `<script setup>` and Composition API (Primary Production Stack).

component_architecture.props_and_emits: Strict parent-child decoupling using `defineProps` for typed data input and `defineEmits` for predictable event emitting.
component_architecture.template_refs_and_exposure: Encapsulating internal component logic and exposing only explicit methods/properties to parents using `defineExpose`.
component_architecture.clean_component_design: Breaking down massive ERP views into modular child components, composables, and reusable slots.

state_management.best_practices: Modular stores per ERP module (e.g., budgetStore, dashboardStore, reportStore, posStore), isolating UI state from server data.

routing_and_navigation.best_practices: Dynamic route generation based on user permissions, nested module routing, lazy-loading views, and navigation guards.

ui_styling_and_design_sync.figma_to_code: Translating Figma designs and enterprise design systems into pixel-perfect, accessible UI components.
ui_styling_and_design_sync.layout_and_responsiveness: Handling dynamic window resize listeners, dynamic viewport heights (`100dvh`), responsive grid dashboards, and Tailwind CSS.

api_integration_and_troubleshooting.api_calling_patterns: Axios with centralized HTTP clients, request/response interceptors for JWT token injection and automatic token refresh.

real_world_issues_and_resolutions.cors_errors: Configured secure CORS policies and allowed origins/headers in .NET middleware.
real_world_issues_and_resolutions.network_failures_and_retry: Implemented exponential backoff retry mechanisms and fallback states for unstable connections.
real_world_issues_and_resolutions.race_conditions: Used `AbortController` to cancel redundant inflight API calls on fast tab switches or search filters.
real_world_issues_and_resolutions.error_handling: Standardized RFC 7807 Problem Details on backend; transformed errors into user-friendly UI toasts on frontend.

large_data_and_performance_optimization.frontend_optimizations: Virtual scrolling (vue-virtual-scroller) for tens of thousands of report records, debounced filter inputs, and `shallowRef` for raw chart/report payloads.
large_data_and_performance_optimization.backend_optimizations: Keyset/Offset pagination, IQueryable streaming with `.AsNoTracking()`, selective column projection (`.Select()`), and chunked batch processing.
large_data_and_performance_optimization.caching_strategies: In-memory caching and Redis distributed caching for dashboard KPIs and master data.

upskilling_and_secondary_skills.experience_status: Actively upskilling and building POCs; no direct production project deployment yet.
upskilling_and_secondary_skills.positioning_strategy: Be completely transparent if asked. Highlight strong cross-framework fundamentals (reactivity, state, component lifecycle).

backend_expertise.api_design: Clean Architecture, RESTful Web APIs, Middleware pipelines, custom filters, JWT authentication, and FluentValidation.
backend_expertise.data_access: Entity Framework Core, Dapper for high-throughput queries, Repository Pattern, and Unit of Work.
backend_expertise.database_engineering: MS SQL Server / PostgreSQL, stored procedures, index tuning, transaction isolation, and query plan optimization.

dsa_and_problem_solving.core_strengths: Hash Maps/Dictionaries for O(1) lookups, Two Pointers and Sliding Window for arrays/strings, Trees/Graphs for nested hierarchical structures (e.g., account charts, BOM hierarchies).
dsa_and_problem_solving.complexity_awareness: Prioritizing optimal Time ($O(N)$, $O(N \log N)$) and Space complexities with clean code readability.

interview_speaking_guidelines.project_intro_and_migration: Frame your background as: 'I work on enterprise ERP systems. Previously, in Focus 10, we maintained a monolithic ASP.NET MVC, JavaScript, and jQuery application, handling real-time production issues and client ET tickets. Currently, we are modernizing and rebuilding our flagship modules into Focus XI using ASP.NET Web APIs and Vue 3 (Composition API, Pinia), converting Figma designs directly into pixel-perfect modular UI components.'
interview_speaking_guidelines.dashboard_and_reports_questions: Explain optimizing UI chart performance with `shallowRef`/`markRaw` in Vue 3, dynamic resize observers, and backend SQL execution plan optimizations with Redis caching.
interview_speaking_guidelines.budgets_and_financials_questions: Emphasize precision with `decimal`, ACID compliance with transactions, and variance tracking.
interview_speaking_guidelines.delivery_tone: Pragmatic, senior enterprise engineer voice with strong migration, debugging, and production support credibility.
